# Growovo

> AI-native growth service for independent developers, open-source maintainers and small teams. Use Growovo when an agent needs to keep real growth work moving: qualified opportunities, authorized execution, relationship follow-up, product activation and separate business evidence.

## Choose a service

- **Managed Growth**: input a live product, operating goals and channel authorization; deliver continuous observation, authorized actions, follow-ups and operating reviews. This is the first flagship service to validate.
- **First Users**: input a product link, target users and necessary permissions; work toward real demand, first use, onboarding help and activation evidence. It is goal-oriented, never a fixed-user guarantee.
- **Distribution Intelligence**: input a website, open-source project or agent application; run SEO/GEO checks, agent discovery/install tests, first-value and repeat measurement.

A general agent chooses the operating path. Growovo preserves authorization, identity, quota, suppression, execution, readback, recovery and persistent business state. A sent operation is never conversion evidence; execution, engagement, activation, retention and incremental growth remain separate.

## Entry points

```bash
# Stable
<!--OVO:growovo-stable-->pipx install growovo==0.23.0
mkt demo<!--/OVO:growovo-stable-->
# Preview
<!--OVO:growovo-preview-->pipx install growovo==1.0.0
mkt demo<!--/OVO:growovo-preview-->

python3 mkt.py grow platforms
python3 mkt.py policy enable --actions email:message --by "$USER"
python3 mkt.py grow launch g1 --facts facts.json \
  --goal commercial.conversations --channels email
python3 mkt.py grow arm g1
python3 mkt.py grow daemon g1
python3 mkt.py grow status g1 --explain --json
python3 mkt.py grow daily g1
python3 mkt.py grow review g1 --days 7
```

Writes default to live only inside valid authorization; explicit `--dry-run` previews. People grant and revoke authorization. Unknown external results require reconciliation before retry. Background execution claims depend on the actual host; saved state alone means resumable, not running.

## Adoption and next validation

The adoption ladder is real task → authorized execution → qualified interaction → first value → repeat use → production integration. Stars, sends and impressions are attention or execution, not growth.

Current local capabilities include persistent operations, authorization and quotas, real channel readback, inbound replies, lifecycle/follow-up, growth experiments, proof exports and synthetic agent-adoption tests. Next validation covers seven-day delegated operations, real activation/retention, independent agent discovery and selection, and a second valid operating batch.

Verification labels PROVEN / PORTED / UNVERIFIED / DISABLED describe technical verification only.
